name: the young Hist's sap spigot and jar at its pool (p02, p13), Heem-Jasa's sap and fungus on her list, and clothes for Tsa-tah, Paa-shei and Heem-Jasa

ref.why: the Hist's sap tap (promises p02, p13: Heem-Jasa draws and sells the young Hist's sap): a Sap Spigot driven into the trunk's east face beside the sealed scar, over the sap pool and facing the walkway where she stands; the plain spigot that yields nothing, since the record's hook says the sick tree's sap no longer runs (Skyrim's harvestable dunSleepingTreeCampSpigot would hand out Sleeping Tree Sap)

a jar of the young Hist's sap set on the root under the spigot (promises p02, p13: the minder sells sap): King of the Murkmire's Hist Sap, the same jar model as Skyrim's Sleeping Tree Sap under the name a Saxhleel camp would give it

items.why: her clothes: a Green Tunic with Sash (cloth with a sash, the cheapest of the sashed tunics; kit priest), the Hist's green and the sash the one mark that she is the tree's minder, in a poor camp
the tree-minder's knife for drawing sap at the scar and cutting fungus: an Argonian bone dagger (bone, T1); nothing forged is carried at the Hist (kit priest)

possessions.why: Heem-Jasa: apothecary, minder of the young Hist; sells sap, swamp fungus and eggshells; teaches alchemy, W2; best tier T1
